title: Strict Chat Prompt Normalizer
summary: Repair a message normalizer so strict chat backends receive one leading system message even when the source prompt contains fragmented system and developer instructions.
fairness_notes: The task is pure Python and has no external dependencies.
The grader checks exact normalized message payloads and input immutability.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden tests include late developer/system fragments after user turns.
Hidden tests check cache_hint preservation when instruction fragments are merged.
